instruction: Candid cinematic still, medium shot at eye-level. In a warmly lit indoor dining room decorated with festive string lights, three people are gathered. On the left, the young woman with hair in two buns (R11), wearing a dark brown leather shirt, is seen from behind hugging the man in the tan blazer (R2). In the center, the man in the tan blazer (R2) smiles warmly with his eyes closed as he embraces her. On the right, the person with short curly hair and glasses (R10), wearing a beige cardigan and turtleneck, stands smiling with hands clasped. The scene is illuminated by warm golden light from string lights, creating a cozy and joyful atmosphere.
elements: R11 is seen from behind while making embrace contact with R2
R2 is the central man receiving R11's embrace and embracing her back
R10 remains outside the R11-R2 embrace with hands clasped
R11 and R2 form the physical contact pair while R10 is an onlooker
the setting is a warmly lit indoor dining room with festive string lights
